interface.signature: def canFinish(n: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The number of courses n is a non-negative integer.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(prerequisites, list) and all(isinstance(pair, list) and len(pair) == 2 for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Prerequisites is a list of pairs, where each pair is a list of two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pair[0] < n and 0 <= pair[1] < n for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each course in the prerequisite pairs is a valid course number between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if it is possible to finish all courses, which is true if and only if there is no cycle in the graph represented by prerequisites.
